cohort: 320 pregnant women with singleton, uncomplicated pregnancies at <12 weeks gestation
finding: Maternal BMI was strongly correlated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, with underweight women experiencing complications like low Apgar scores and anaemia, while overweight/obese women had higher risks of gestational diabetes, PIH, and LGA newborns.
birth_weight: Birth weight was assessed (LGA, SGA mentioned)
